title: Normalized scheme tangent identifications and open restriction
statement: Use the marked proper deformation classes of [def-sfb-proper-scheme-deformation-data] and ordinary marked scheme lifts of [def-sfb-marked-scheme-lifts]. The two recorded dual-number ring models have the coordinate isomorphism $(a,b)\mapsto(a,b)$; transport of a proper lift to the ordinary model is a scheme isomorphism preserving the marking and commuting with the projection through this spectrum isomorphism. Put $E_X=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(L_{X/k},\mathcal O_X[1])$ using the full standard sheaf cotangent complex and derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its $k$-module structure is the canonical derived structural scalar action. The coefficient map $\mathcal O_X\otimes_k k\to\mathcal O_X$ is the pinned tensor-pullback unit map [def-pc-module-pullback]. A tangent identification consists of the split classification of [def-sfb-scheme-lift-classification-data], the section-normalized sheaf extension classification of [lem-sfb-zariski-sheaf-algebra-extension-ext], and the following data for every coefficient module $M$ and every marked lift $Y$ over $k\oplus M$. Supply its actual LiftKernel, an isomorphism from its pulled-back base conormal coefficient to $\mathcal O_X\otimes_k M$, normalized on every section $g$ representing $\epsilon m$ by $g\mapsto1\otimes m$, and a SplitLiftExtension with that kernel and coefficient isomorphism, as defined in [def-sfb-scheme-coefficient-extension-problems]. Require for every finite-dimensional $M$, every such $Y$, and every normalized conormal representative $a$ that split.classes sends $[Y]$ to extensionClass sheaf (extension $Y$) $a$. The sheaf classification requires such conormal representatives to exist and pins their maps on all polynomial relations and differential sections, so this equation is not vacuous. Finally supply vector operations on the ordinary dual-number class set and a $k$-linear equivalence to $E_X$, equal on every marked lift to this pinned split Ext class followed by the coefficient-unit map. Tangent naturality consists of these identifications for $X$ and every open $U$, the normalized open cotangent comparisons of [def-sfb-scheme-cotangent-open-restriction], and maps on classes characterized by every actual cartesian restriction, whose existence is required. The open tangent identification of a restricted class is the derived restriction of its Ext class, with the canonical restriction and coefficient-unit comparisons.
